title: dysoda foetida
intro: Dysoda foetida, commonly known as Indian squill or wild garlic, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dysoda foetida include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
